title: The Enemy's Beast Knelt to Me
summary: A farm kid stands his ground before the Kingtaker. The war stag kneels and carries him to the castle of stolen thrones, where the mountain begins to stand.
frame_0: A red-tunicked farm kid stands beneath the bowed, gold-eyed black stag and its crowned antlers. Green grass, the blue sky and the opposing hosts frame the encounter.
package_differences: Jake approved the blue-sky valley and requested steady opening coverage followed by a continuous camera from 25 seconds.
The sponsor edition uses the revised 9.3-second Flashloop ending with the approved narrator recording.
The score and effects drop out before the kneel. The locked narration continues through that interval.
The bear and boar wrestle in the opening. The Kingtaker’s first kneel is held in a single composition with the boy and the red army. The goat memory appears in a polished crown in the court.
The valley, goat, hooves, crowns, crowds and impacts use licensed CC0 recordings from Freesound and Kenney's Foley libraries.
On 'owns your town' the camera shows the farmers and their crown. The helmeted goat rears once, bolts across the shot and leaves its helmet behind.
PART 2 shares the supplied 'part' interval, 96.710–97.201 s. Script and SRT include 2. The recording is used verbatim.
Two instrumental orchestral themes follow the approach and the gift of the crowns. The score leaves the kneel impact, the goat joke and key replies exposed.
